snippet.title: Tower Dominion - Official Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Shape the battlefield to your advantage in Tower Dominion, a roguelike tower defense game where every run offers new strategic possibilities. Expand and customize procedurally generated maps with a modular building system, adapt your defenses, and create powerful strategies with each playthrough. Coming to Nintendo Switch on August 13, followed by PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S on August 14.

👉 add it to your wishlist:
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/tower-dominion-switch/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018629
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/tower-dominion/9p5qlmx9nc8s

🎮 main channel: https://www.youtube.com/@explorerdotgames
